description:
Use this when the user asks which Indian stocks hit their upper or lower circuit on a day, or how often a stock has.

NSE's official list of securities that hit their price band (circuit) on a day.

    `date` (default newest day) lists every hit; `symbol` returns that security's hits over `days`
    (default 90, max 1825). `direction`: upper | lower | all (default). `limit` 1..500 (default 200).
    The list is the exchange's own record, which OHLC alone cannot reproduce: a stock can touch its band
    intraday and close inside it. A security can appear as both upper and lower in one day. From
    2010. Facts only.
name: get_price_band_hits
title: Price band hits
